goal: Create reusable Liquid Glass-styled primitives used across apps and overlays.
summary: Phase 4 completed (retry): strengthened the Liquid Glass primitive library and verification. Added real focus/ARIA/state assertions in GlassPrimitives.test.tsx (focus via .focus(), aria-disabled on disabled GlassButton, aria-current on active GlassSidebarItem, computed backdrop-filter inline styles on GlassPanel). Added inline backdrop-filter styles to GlassPanel so the Liquid Glass blur is both testable in jsdom and robust in browser. Added a Playwright e2e integration test (e2e/system-settings.spec.ts) that opens System Settings from the Dock, asserts the glass panel has a blur backdrop-filter, toggles the theme, and captures a screenshot. All 50 unit tests pass; all 11 e2e tests pass; production build succeeds.
stepSummaries:
1. Implement GlassPanel, GlassButton, GlassSidebar, GlassToolbar, and GlassPopover components with backdrop-filter. [verified]
  2. Add light/dark/tinted variants and a global theme toggle in System Settings scaffold. [verified]
  3. Add focus/active states and subtle hover transitions. [verified]
